Reject fact/near-miss examples that introduce another approved fact, contradict or invent details. Procedure cases must obey all environmental thresholds and retest prerequisites; reject ambiguous or wrong replacement advice. Unknown questions must request an untold detail, and answers must acknowledge ignorance. General answers must be correct and not use Halvard. Do not reject harmless wording variations or correct equivalent units.
